display.title: {"text": "The Bumblezone"}
description: A whole dimension of puzzles: cell mazes, the Sempiternal Sanctum's colour puzzles, battle cubes and parkour. Brains over armour.
&ePrepare:&r Bee-friendly gear (Bumblezone's own), patience. Solving puzzles gives the better chests.
&eSignature rewards:&r Honeyed Seals (exchange for Verdant/Splendor gems), puzzle-treasure cores. Failed-puzzle chests give little.
&eComing back:&r Many sanctums and mazes; rewards scale with puzzle success.
&eFeeds into:&r Seals -> utility gems; honey for food and building.
&aDo:&r Walk into any the bumblezone structure (early-mid game).
&6You get:&r Honeyed Seals (exchange for Verdant/Splendor gems), puzzle-treasure cores. Failed-puzzle chests give little.
